title: Moluccans - Wikipedia
text: May 29, 2026 - Moluccans are the Melanesian-Austronesian ethnic groups indigenous to the Maluku Islands (also called the Moluccas). The region was historically known as the Spice Islands, and today consists of two Indonesian provinces of Maluku and North Maluku.
